title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:265 Rate limit case mismatch allows bypass via hex case variants
description: Rate limiting uses original case of from_hex while sequence tracking uses from_hex.lower(). An attacker can bypass rate limits by varying case of the same node ID (e.g., 'AABB...' and 'aabb...' and 'AaBb...' are separate rate-limit buckets but share one sequence counter). Each of the 2^n case variants (where n is the number of hex letters a-f) gets its own 'first_sos' pass, allowing far more than SOS_HOURLY_MAX=3 or SOS_BURST_MAX=2 per source.
close_reason: Fixed by wave-fix: changed evaluate_rate_limit and _record_request calls to use source_key (lowercased) instead of from_hex (original case) for consistent case-insensitive tracking
